summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness web client plugin that adds three-mode input steering (now/next/later) plus queue management with freeze and resume controls to help users organize how pending messages are processed.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is a user-facing workflow orchestration utility for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, centered on managing what happens when the agent is busy. Evidence shows it is a Cordis client-side extension (no core source edits) that reimplements busy-input behavior with a three-level steering model (now/next/later), adds an in-console queue management panel, and includes freeze/resume controls; therefore its primary purpose is orchestrating interaction flow rather than generating code, accessing files, or connecting external services.
